response.justification: While Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain knowledge through GISCollective and Green Map work, plus systems-level exposure via microservices and low-latency development, he has a critical gap: no modern C++ experience for 10+ years and no Rust experience. For a Mid-Senior role where C++ is the primary requirement and immediate productivity is expected, this is disqualifying. His recent career trajectory toward full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, AI infrastructure) indicates a move away from the systems-level programming this role demands.
strengths: Rare geospatial and GIS domain expertise through GISCollective and Green Map work, providing valuable context for routing and tiling systems
Proven systems-level thinking from microservices infrastructure handling millions of requests/second and low-latency development at Dunnhumby using asynchronous I/O and high-performance databases
Strong software engineering discipline including TDD, testing framework creation, open-source contributions, and demonstrated quality-first mindset across multiple roles
concerns: Critical gap in modern C++ development—last significant C++ work was 2014-2015 at National Instruments; lacks both C++ and Rust experience required for the primary role responsibility
No demonstrated experience with navigation systems, routing algorithms, tile-based data structures, or real-time traffic integration despite strong geospatial background

Recent career direction toward full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, AI infrastructure at re:cinq) suggests a shift away from systems-level and performance-critical programming required for this pipeline role
